scope: Fresh root process, private 30-second compound with supplied 4K source and 480x270 child/root canvases, ordinary maximized editor
observations: Both monitors show the beach at frame zero after root reload.
Fit displays the full 30-second compound filmstrip and processed waveform.
Play advances program picture, time and playhead to 00:00:05:33; both meters respond and Audio playing is visible.
Stop pauses and clears both meters with Stopped / silent.
Rewind restores visible beach, zero program timecode and zero playhead.
Paused seek completes at 00:00:18:51 with sloth picture, matching program timecode, status and marker; Source remains zero.
Scopes displays histogram, RGB parade and luma waveform for the sloth.
Dragging the playhead to 00:00:02:10 completes with the beach picture, matching time/status/marker and changed histogram, parade and luma waveform.
limits: Scope sampling is from the fitted 480x270 program frame, not a full native 4K scan.
Transient pending seeks retain the previous presented picture until the new frame arrives.
No physical-hearing, speaker/display alignment, fullscreen native-resolution, sustained 60fps or zero-drop cadence claim.
Held and viewport-cache behavior have native regression evidence; this UI exercise uses an ordinary moving compound.
